SessionNotes: Fished the rising tide through the morning high. Croaker held in the inside trough and bit in short windows.
Fished live anchovies around the Marina del Rey north jetty. Mixed bass and a shovelnose came as the tide filled in.
Covered water with a five-inch white swimbait. Water looked fishable but there were no strikes or visible bait.
Timed a low tide near dawn and worked the trough and edges of exposed structure. Landed one short and one legal halibut.
